start: Settings → Workouts → Rest timer and sounds; workout sounds on; ringer normal

user_sees: Sheet 'Default rest' with 'Used for every exercise that has no rest time of its own.'
The row shows the new length

steps.action: Start a workout and tick a set on an exercise with no rest of its own
user_sees: The rest bar counts down from 2:00
2:15 left
must_not: The end alert still set for the old time

steps.action: Wait for zero with the app open
user_sees: One buzz and the picked rest-over sound
The bar turns red and counts the extra time ('+0:10 over')
The over count stops and a new rest starts

start: A rest running; the member locks the phone

steps.action: Lock the phone until the rest ends
user_sees: The 'Rest is over' notification rings on time
must_not: The alert deleted as it appears

steps.action: First time only: answer the on-time alert ask
user_sees: The ask to hear 'Rest is over' on time, with Allow and Not now
must_not: The ask shown again before 7 days after Not now

start: 'Open MettleUp on my watch' on; a Wear OS watch connected

user_sees: MettleUp opens on the watch
must_not: The watch app opening when the switch is off

steps.action: Tick a set, then tap +15 on the watch card
user_sees: The phone's rest bar also gains 15 seconds
must_not: Phone and watch showing different times left

start: Rest timer and sounds; the default rest save fails, or sounds are off

steps.action: Pick a default rest while saving fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't save it. It applies until the app closes.'
The sheet stays open
must_not: The sheet closing as if saved

steps.action: Set the default rest to none and tick a set on an exercise with no rest
user_sees: No rest starts
must_not: A rest of 0 seconds ringing at once

steps.action: Turn 'Workout sounds' off and let a rest end
user_sees: 'Workout sounds are off, so Rest is over only buzzes.'
A buzz, no sound
must_not: A sound while sounds are off

start: A rest running after ticking set 2

user_sees: The rest stops
must_not: The bell ringing for an unticked set

steps.action: Turn 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' on, then off, with Do Not Disturb on
user_sees: On: 'Rest is over' rings through; off: it is held, buzz too
must_not: A sound through Do Not Disturb while the switch is off

start: A new install; Do Not Disturb permission never used

steps.action: Look at 'Ring through Do Not Disturb'
user_sees: Off by default
must_not: The app ringing through Do Not Disturb without the member turning it on

user_sees: The phone's Do Not Disturb access asked for, used only for 'Rest is over'
must_not: The access used for any other sound
